    SELECT ss.cds, ss.`AvgScrMath`
    FROM satscores AS ss
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT cds, `AvgScrMath`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `AvgScrMath` IS NOT NULL AND `AvgScrMath` > 560
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT f.`School Code`, f.`Charter Funding Type`
    FROM c_rows r
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON r.cds = f.`CDSCode`
),
t_rows AS (
    SELECT `School Code`
    FROM t_join
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
),
final_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
    FROM t_rows
)
SELECT * FROM final_count;

    SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, a.date
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.client_id = 992
),
c_client_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount, l.payments, l.status
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.client_id = 992
),
c_client_debt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_debt,
        SUM(l.payments) AS total_payments,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS active_loans,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'P' THEN 1 END) AS pending_loans,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS closed_loans
    FROM c_client_loans AS l
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT total_debt FROM c_client_debt) AS total_debt,
    (SELECT total_payments FROM c_client_debt) AS total_payments,
    (SELECT active_loans FROM c_client_debt) AS active_loans,
    (SELECT pending_loans FROM c_client_debt) AS pending_loans,
    (SELECT closed_loans FROM c_client_debt) AS closed_loans;

    SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_id, b.bond_type
    FROM molecule AS m
    LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR047'
       OR m.molecule_id LIKE '%TR047%'
       OR m.molecule_id LIKE 'TR047%'
       OR m.molecule_id LIKE '%TR047'
       OR m.molecule_id LIKE '%TR%047%'
),
c_double_bonds AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM c_check
    JOIN bond ON c_check.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
),
c_total_bonds AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_bond_count
    FROM c_check
    JOIN bond ON c_check.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
)
SELECT (double_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percent
FROM c_double_bonds, c_total_bonds;

WITH c_info AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.`artist`, c.`asciiName`, c.`hasContentWarning`, c.`originalText`, c.`text`, c.`flavorText`, c.`faceName`, c.`name`, c.`uuid`
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE 
        (c.artist LIKE '%Stephen Daniele%' 
         OR c.artist LIKE 'Stephen Daniele%' 
         OR c.artist LIKE '%Stephen Daniele' 
         OR c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
         OR c.artist LIKE 'Stephen% Daniele%'
         OR c.artist LIKE 'Stephen Daniele%')
),
c_final AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.`artist`, c.`asciiName`, c.`hasContentWarning`, c.`originalText`, c.`text`, c.`flavorText`, c.`faceName`, c.`name`, c.`uuid`, r.text AS ruling_text
    FROM c_info c
    INNER JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
)
SELECT id, artist, asciiName, hasContentWarning, originalText, text, flavorText, faceName, name, uuid, ruling_text
FROM c_final
ORDER BY id;

483.sql:
SELECT 
    rulings.text AS italian_text_ruling
FROM 
    rulings
JOIN 
    cards ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
JOIN 
    sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE 
    sets.name = 'Coldsnap'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM set_translations
        WHERE set_translations.setCode = sets.code
        AND set_translations.language = 'Italian'
    )
ORDER BY 
    rulings.date DESC;

436.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT `id`, `frameEffects`
    FROM cards
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT `id`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `frameEffects` = 'extendedart'
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT c.`id`
    FROM c_rows c
    JOIN foreign_data f ON c.`id` = f.`id`
),
final_ids AS (
    SELECT `id`
    FROM t_join
),
final_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
    FROM final_ids
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, `id`
FROM final_ids
GROUP BY `id`
ORDER BY `id`;

JOIN `hero_power` ON `superhero`.`id` = `hero_power`.`hero_id`
GROUP BY `superhero`.`id`
HAVING COUNT(`hero_power`.`power_id`) > 15
ORDER BY `superhero`.`full_name` ASC;

847.sql:
WITH c_rows AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.q2
    FROM qualifying AS q
    WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
t_lap AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, d.surname, MIN(r.q2) AS best_q2
    FROM c_rows r
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    GROUP BY r.driverId
),
t_final AS (
    SELECT t.driverId, d.surname
    FROM t_lap t
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON t.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE t.best_q2 = (
        SELECT MIN(q2)
        FROM c_rows
        WHERE raceId = 19
    )
)
SELECT surname
FROM t_final;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT t.`team_long_name`, ta.`buildUpPlayPassing`, ta.`date`
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN Team t ON ta.`team_api_id` = t.`id`
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT `team_long_name`, `buildUpPlayPassing`, `date`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `date` IS NOT NULL AND `buildUpPlayPassing` IS NOT NULL
),
c_date AS (
    SELECT `team_long_name`, `buildUpPlayPassing`
    FROM c_rows
    WHERE strftime('%Y', `date`) = '2012'
),
c_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(`buildUpPlayPassing`) AS avg_buildUpPlayPassing
    FROM c_date
),
c_result AS (
    SELECT `team_long_name`
    FROM c_date
    WHERE `buildUpPlayPassing` > (SELECT avg_buildUpPlayPassing FROM c_avg)
)
SELECT `team_long_name`
FROM c_result;

    FROM c_sex
)

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT t.`GasStationID`, t.`Amount`
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT `GasStationID`, SUM(`Amount`) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM c_cols
    GROUP BY `GasStationID`
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT r.`GasStationID`, r.TotalRevenue, gs.`ChainID`
    FROM c_rows r
    INNER JOIN gasstations gs ON r.`GasStationID` = gs.`GasStationID`
),
final_answer AS (
    SELECT `GasStationID`
    FROM t_join
    ORDER BY `TotalRevenue` DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT `GasStationID` AS `GasStationID`
FROM final_answer;
